- 2026 renewal price: USD 1,920 per seat per year, with a 10% discount to USD 1,728 (term runs to 2027-03-31)
- Roughly $300k ARR, from an October 2025 CRM note
- Roughly $25k a month invoicing, from an October 2025 email

Tell me which one Hollis should get and I'll send it to him directly. I won't post the figure in any channel. Hollis isn't on the Quarrendon account team, so this is a finance figure and needs your go-ahead, which you've given by asking.
